column2: DEPUTY PARLIAMENTARY BUDGET OFFICER, ADVISORY COMMITTEE
AND THE STAFF OF THE PARLIAMENTARY BUDGET OFFICE
5. Subject to the provisions of this Part, the Parliamentary
Budget Officer shall be appointed by the President on the
recommendation  of  the  Constitutional  Council.  The
Parliamentary Budget Officer shall be the chief executive
officer of the Parliamentary Budget Office.
